description: Search 100,000+ real recipes for ones that can be cooked from a given list of ingredients, and say exactly what is MISSING from each. Common cupboard staples (salt, oil, flour, common spices and 380 others) are assumed to be on hand and are never reported as missing. Results are ranked by how much of the given list a recipe uses minus how many extra items it would require the cook to buy, so the top result is the one that needs the fewest trips to a shop. Use this whenever someone asks what they can make from ingredients they already have.

ingredients.description: What the cook has, e.g. ["chicken thighs","rice","half an onion"]. Free text per item is fine; quantities are ignored.

max_results.description: How many recipes to return (1-12, default 6).

name: find_recipes_from_ingredients
title: Find recipes from what is in the fridge
